+  let ψ := algebraMap A p.asIdeal.ResidueField

+  have hchart : g ≫ hU.isoSpec.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) := by
+    dsimp [g, openResiduePoint, φ, e, ψ, p, z]
+    rw [Category.assoc, ← Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField]
+    rw [← Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField]

+  let V := (Modules.overEquiv U).functor
+  let B := (Modules.overEquiv U).inverse

+        (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft RC (Modules.overEquiv U).counitIso) ≪≫

+  let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{v, v, v} e.hom.hom

+/-- Termwise residue extension computes local derived fibre cohomology naturally
+on every strictly perfect complex. Source: Stacks Project, Tags 01IB, 08DW and 06YJ.
+(blueprint: new-affine-perfect-residue-model-naturality)
+
+Proof: Work in the full subcategory of strictly perfect complexes. Transport each
+complex by the canonical over-site equivalence. Boundedness and finite-free
+retractions imply K-flatness, so the chosen derived-pullback counit is invertible
+on this whole subcategory. Compute its ordinary pullback by the natural affine
+associated-sheaf/base-change formula, using the natural terminal-section
+reconstruction counit. The canonical field transport makes the coefficient map
+exactly section evaluation. Take homology and global sections on the residue
+spectrum; these sections are exact and undo associated sheaves. All factors
+are natural isomorphisms on the full subcategory, giving the stated family and
+its equation for every chain map. -/
+theorem affine_perfect_residue_model_naturality
+    (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
+    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+        ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
+      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
+    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+    let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+    let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) :=
+      IsStrictlyPerfect W U
+    Nonempty (P.ι ⋙ G ⋙
+        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} (W.residueField w)) (.up ℤ) 1 ≅
+      P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w U hwU 1) := by
+  dsimp only
+  classical
+  let D := SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)
+  let A := SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)
+  let B := SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (Spec (W.residueField w)).toRingedSpace)
+  let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex D ℤ) := IsStrictlyPerfect W U
+  let ι := P.ι
+  let V : D ⥤ A := (Modules.overEquiv U).functor
+  have : V.IsEquivalence := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+      exact (Modules.overEquiv U).isEquivalence_functor
+  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits V := inferInstance
+  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits V := inferInstance
+  have : V.Additive := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+      exact Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  let Vc := V.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+  let g := openResiduePoint W w U hwU
+  obtain ⟨hEadd, ε, _, hflat⟩ := tensorDerivedCounit g
+  let E : A ⥤ B := Modules.tensorPullback g
+  have : E.Additive := hEadd
+  let Ec := E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+  have hε : IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft
+      ((ι ⋙ Vc) ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient A (.up ℤ)) ε) := by
+    apply (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app _).2
+    intro K
+    exact hflat (Vc.obj K.obj) (strictlyPerfect_overEquiv_isKFlat W U K.obj K.property)
+  have := hε
+  obtain ⟨c⟩ : Nonempty ((ι ⋙ Vc) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q.{v + 1} ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
+      (ι ⋙ Vc) ⋙ Ec ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q.{v + 1}) := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false in
+      exact counitComparison E (derivedPullback g) (ι ⋙ Vc) ε
+  let PG : A ⥤ B := Modules.pullback g
+  have : PG.Additive := Modules.instAdditivePullback g
+  let J : D ⥤ B := V ⋙ PG
+  have : J.Additive := inferInstanceAs (V ⋙ PG).Additive
+  let τ : E ≅ PG :=
+    (Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction g).some.leftAdjointUniq
+      (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
+  obtain ⟨c'⟩ : Nonempty (ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ V.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
+      derivedPullback g ≅ ι ⋙ J.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false in
+      exact ⟨Functor.isoWhiskerLeft ι (Functor.isoWhiskerRight V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors
+        (derivedPullback g)) ≪≫ c ≪≫
+        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (ι ⋙ Vc)
+          (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex τ (.up ℤ))) DerivedCategory.Q ≪≫
+        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft ι
+          (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (V ⋙ PG)) (.up ℤ)))
+            DerivedCategory.Q⟩

+    SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+  have : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
+    ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+  let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
+  have : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+  let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+  let Sh := affinePerfectSheafification W U hU
+  have : Sh.Additive := by

+      have : TA.Additive := ⟨by intros; exact tilde.map_add _ _⟩

+        Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _

+      infer_instance

+  have : L.Additive := ⟨by intros; exact tilde.map_add _ _⟩

+  have : IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft ι ρ) :=
+    (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app _).2 (fun K ↦ hρ K.obj K.property)
+  obtain ⟨α'⟩ := residueTermComparison W w U hwU hU
+  let α : Sh ⋙ J ≅ T ⋙ L := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in exact α'
+  let r := asIso (Functor.whiskerLeft ι ρ)
+  obtain ⟨a⟩ : Nonempty (ι ⋙ J.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
+      ι ⋙ G ⋙ L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) :=
+    ⟨Functor.isoWhiskerRight r.symm (J.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≪≫
+      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (ι ⋙ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
+        ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (Sh ⋙ J)) (.up ℤ)) ≪≫

+          (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (T ⋙ L)) (.up ℤ)).symm)⟩
+  obtain ⟨d⟩ : Nonempty (ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ V.mapDerivedCategory ⋙

+/-- Terminal-section reconstruction is a natural transformation, invertible on
+strictly perfect complexes. Source: Stacks Project, Tag 01IB.
+(blueprint: new-affine-perfect-sections-counit)
+
+Proof: Transport the tilde/sections adjunction along the canonical affine-chart
+equivalence. The transported sections functor is naturally terminal evaluation.
+Use this identification in the adjunction counit, then apply it termwise to
+complexes. Each term of a strictly perfect complex is in the essential image
+of sheafification by the affine perfect module model. The fully faithful
+left adjoint has invertible counit on that image. Thus every component of
+the complex counit is invertible, so the complex map itself is invertible.
+Boundedness is unused in this reconstruction step. -/

+    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
+    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤

+  have : E.inverse.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _

+  have : T.Additive := ⟨by intros; exact tilde.map_add _ _⟩
+  have : T.Full := inferInstanceAs (tilde.functor A).Full
+  have : T.Faithful := inferInstanceAs (tilde.functor A).Faithful
+  have : E.functor.Full := inferInstance
+  have : E.functor.Faithful := inferInstance

+  let adj : Sh ⊣ H := tilde.adjunction.comp E.toAdjunction
+  have : Sh.Full := Functor.Full.comp (F := T) (G := E.functor)
+  have : Sh.Faithful := Functor.Faithful.comp (F := T) (G := E.functor)
+  have : Sh.Additive := inferInstanceAs (T ⋙ E.functor).Additive
+  have : H.IsRightAdjoint := adj.isRightAdjoint
+  have : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)).PreservesZeroMorphisms := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
+  have : H.PreservesZeroMorphisms := inferInstance
+  have : H.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _

+    dsimp only [Sh, E, T, affinePerfectSheafification]
+    rw [sectionsChartEquivalence_functor]
+    rfl
+  let e := sectionsSpecChartEquivalence W U hU
+  let rG := Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.inv
+  let S := moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)
+  let β : rG ≅ SheafOfModules.pushforward hU.isoSpec.hom.toRingCatSheafHom :=
+    e.toAdjunction.rightAdjointUniq (Modules.restrictAdjunction hU.isoSpec.hom)

+    SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))

+  obtain ⟨α⟩ := overChartSectionsIso W U hU

+    rw [sectionsChartEquivalence_inverse]
+    rfl

+      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight β S) ≪≫ α

+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 0098 and 010V.

+

+private def restrictionHomologyIso
+    {A B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (i : ℤ) :
+    HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} B) (.up ℤ) i ⋙
+      ModuleCat.restrictScalars f ≅
+    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
+      HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (.up ℤ) i :=
+  NatIso.ofComponents (fun K ↦ ((K.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f)).symm)
+    (fun g ↦ ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality
+      ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor _ _ i).map g) (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f))
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Scalar extension, residue restriction and quotient carriers use different module structures.
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true in
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types true in
+/-- The affine cycle quotient agrees naturally with homology after residue evaluation.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 0098 and 010V.
+(blueprint: new-affine-residue-evaluation-homology-naturality)
+
+Proof: The kernel hypothesis identifies p with the point of the canonical affine
+chart. Its prime residue field and the scheme residue field are canonically
+isomorphic. The natural scalar-transport comparison identifies extension to the
+prime residue field followed by restriction along that isomorphism with extension
+by section evaluation. Restriction preserves homology. Compose its natural
+homology comparison, the natural scalar-transport comparison of complexes, and
+the quotient-to-homology comparison. Naturality of these factors gives the
+equation for every complex map. Perfectness is not required. -/
+theorem affine_residue_evaluation_homology_naturality
+    (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
+    (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
+    (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom) :
+    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+        ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
+      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
+    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+    let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+    ∃ e : ∀ K, affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ (G.obj K).homology 1,
+      ∀ K C (φ : K ⟶ C) z,
+        e C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) =
+          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map φ) 1 (e K z) := by
+  classical
+  dsimp only
+  have hp' : p = (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨w, hwU⟩).asIdeal := by
+    rw [hp, hU.isoSpec_hom_apply]
+    ext a
+    change W.evaluation U w hwU a = 0 ↔
+      W.presheaf.germ U w hwU a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
+    exact IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _
+  clear hp
+  subst p
+  let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+      ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+  have : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
+    ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+  have : (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨w, hwU⟩).asIdeal.IsPrime := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in infer_instance
+  let κ := (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨w, hwU⟩).asIdeal.ResidueField
+  have : IsIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap ⟨w, hwU⟩) := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in infer_instance
+  have : IsIso (hU.isoSpec.hom.residueFieldMap ⟨w, hwU⟩) := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in infer_instance
+  let e := asIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap ⟨w, hwU⟩) ≪≫
+    (asIso (hU.isoSpec.hom.residueFieldMap ⟨w, hwU⟩)).symm ≪≫
+      Spec.residueFieldIso Γ(W, U) (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨w, hwU⟩)
+  let S := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (algebraMap Γ(W, U) κ)
+  have : S.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+  let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{v, v, v} e.hom.hom
+  let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
+  have : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+  let Gp := (F ⋙ S).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+  let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+  obtain ⟨δ'⟩ := affine_residue_scalar_transport W U hU ⟨w, hwU⟩
+  let δ : S ⋙ R ≅ T := δ'
+  let σ : Gp ⋙ R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅ G := by
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false in
+      exact Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
+        (Functor.associator F S R ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerLeft F δ) (.up ℤ)
+  let γ : Gp ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} κ) (.up ℤ) 1 ⋙ R ≅
+      G ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor
+        (ModuleCat.{v} (W.residueField w)) (.up ℤ) 1 :=
+    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft Gp (restrictionHomologyIso e.hom.hom 1) ≪≫
+      Functor.isoWhiskerRight σ
+        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} (W.residueField w)) (.up ℤ) 1)
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := affine_residue_quotient_homology_naturality
+    W U (hU.isoSpec.hom ⟨w, hwU⟩).asIdeal
+  refine ⟨fun K ↦ (q K).trans (γ.app K).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv, ?_⟩
+  intro K C φ z
+  change (γ.app C).hom (q C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z)) = _
+  rw [hq K C φ z]
+  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (γ.hom.naturality φ) (q K z)
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+/-- The affine model comparison can be chosen naturally for every represented arrow.

+is invertible on finite free modules and their retracts. Its termwise natural
+counit reconstructs every strictly perfect complex. The section complex is
+bounded and termwise projective, hence K-flat. Factor the residue point through
+U and use the natural derived open-restriction comparison. The K-flat pullback

+field isomorphism obtained from hp identifies this tensor complex with the
+explicit affineResidueTerm complex. The canonical identification of homology
+with cycles modulo incoming boundaries is natural in chain maps. Compose these
+natural comparisons with the specified model isomorphisms m and m'. The source
+comparison is fixed before the target or arrow is chosen. Naturality identifies
+the residue homology map with derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor applied to b when
+Q(phi) is m.inv followed by the restricted b and m'.hom. All terms in this
+identity depend only on Q(phi), so it holds for every such representative.
+No geometric direct-image hypothesis enters this argument. -/
+theorem affine_residue_model_naturality
+    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
+      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
+    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
+    (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
+    (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
+    (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom)
+    (E : schemeDerivedCategory W)
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
+    (m : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
+      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) :
+    ∃ eK : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w,
+      ∀ (E' : schemeDerivedCategory W) (b : E ⟶ E')
+        (C : CochainComplex
+          (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+        (_hC : IsStrictlyPerfect W U C)
+        (m' : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
+          (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E' ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C),
+        ∃ eC : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p C ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E' 1 w,
+          ∀ (φ : K ⟶ C), DerivedCategory.Q.map φ =
+              m.inv ≫ (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
+                (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map b ≫ m'.hom →
+            ∀ z : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K,
+              eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) =
+                (derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w 1).map b (eK z) := by

+    (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
+  let H := localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w U hwU 1
+  let A := derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w 1
+  obtain ⟨θ⟩ := derived_fiber_open_factorization W w U hwU 1
+  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := affine_residue_evaluation_homology_naturality W w U hwU hU p hp
+  obtain ⟨t⟩ := affine_perfect_residue_model_naturality W w U hwU hU
+  let oK : H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ A.obj E :=
+    H.mapIso m.symm ≪≫ θ.app E
+  let eK := (q K).trans (t.app ⟨K, hK⟩).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv

+  intro E' b C hC m'
+  let oC : H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≅ A.obj E' :=
+    H.mapIso m'.symm ≪≫ θ.app E'
+  let eC := (q C).trans (t.app ⟨C, hC⟩).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv
+  refine ⟨eC.trans oC.toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv, ?_⟩
+  intro φ hφ z
+  have hlocal : eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) =
+      H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ) (eK z) := by
+    change (t.app ⟨C, hC⟩).hom (q C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z)) = _
+    rw [hq K C φ z]
+    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+      (t.hom.naturality (X := ⟨K, hK⟩) (Y := ⟨C, hC⟩) (ObjectProperty.homMk φ))
+        (q K z)

+    dsimp only [oC, oK, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
+    rw [hφ, H.map_comp, H.map_comp]
+    simp only [Category.assoc]

+    have hn := θ.hom.naturality b
+    dsimp only [Functor.comp_map] at hn
+    change H.map (R.map b) ≫ (θ.app E').hom = (θ.app E).hom ≫ A.map b at hn
+    exact congrArg (fun a ↦ H.map m.inv ≫ a) hn
+  change oC.hom (eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z)) = A.map b (oK.hom (eK z))
+  rw [hlocal]
+  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hsquare (eK z)
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+/-! # The natural quotient-to-homology comparison for affine residue complexes
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 010V; Mathlib's concrete module homology API.

+set_option autoImplicit false

+noncomputable section
+
+variable (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens) (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
+
+private abbrev sectionsFunctor :
+    SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+      ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) :=
+  SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+
+private instance sectionsFunctor_additive : (sectionsFunctor W U).Additive :=
+  inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+
+private abbrev residueFunctor :=
+  ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (algebraMap Γ(W, U) p.ResidueField)
+
+private instance residueFunctor_additive : (residueFunctor W U p).Additive :=
+  (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+
+private abbrev residueComplexFunctor :=
+  ((sectionsFunctor W U ⋙ residueFunctor W U p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
+
+private def termIso
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) (j : ℤ) :
+    affineResidueTerm W U p K j ≃+ ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).X j :=
+  let a : p.ResidueField ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)]
+      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap Γ(W, U) p.ResidueField)).obj
+        (ModuleCat.of p.ResidueField p.ResidueField) :=
+    { AddEquiv.refl p.ResidueField with map_smul' := fun r x ↦ Algebra.smul_def r x }
+  (TensorProduct.congr a
+    (LinearEquiv.refl Γ(W, U) ((sectionsFunctor W U).obj (K.X j)))).toAddEquiv
+
+private theorem termIso_d
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (i j : ℤ) (x : affineResidueTerm W U p K i) :
+    termIso W U p K j (affineResidueDifferential W U p K i j x) =
+      ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).d i j (termIso W U p K i x) := by
+  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
+  | zero => simp
+  | tmul r m => rfl
+  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
+
+private theorem termIso_map
+    {K C : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ}
+    (φ : K ⟶ C) (j : ℤ) (x : affineResidueTerm W U p K j) :
+    termIso W U p C j (affineResidueComponent φ j x) =
+      ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ).f j (termIso W U p K j x) := by
+  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
+  | zero => simp
+  | tmul r m => rfl
+  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
+
+private def cycleIso
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) :
+    affineResidueCycles W U p K ≃+
+      LinearMap.ker (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).g.hom where
+  toFun x := ⟨termIso W U p K 1 x.val, by
+    change ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).d 1 2 (termIso W U p K 1 x.val) = 0
+    rw [← termIso_d, x.property, map_zero]⟩
+  invFun x := ⟨(termIso W U p K 1).symm x.val, by
+    apply (termIso W U p K 2).injective
+    rw [termIso_d, (termIso W U p K 1).apply_symm_apply, map_zero]
+    exact x.property⟩
+  left_inv x := Subtype.ext ((termIso W U p K 1).symm_apply_apply x.val)
+  right_inv x := Subtype.ext ((termIso W U p K 1).apply_symm_apply x.val)
+  map_add' x y := Subtype.ext ((termIso W U p K 1).map_add x.val y.val)
+
+private theorem boundaries_map
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) :
+    (affineResidueBoundaries W U p K).map (cycleIso W U p K).toAddMonoidHom =
+      (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).moduleCatToCycles.range.toAddSubgroup := by
+  ext x
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
+    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy
+    refine ⟨termIso W U p K 0 z, ?_⟩
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).d 0 1 (termIso W U p K 0 z) =
+      termIso W U p K 1 y.val
+    rw [← termIso_d, hz]
+    rfl
+  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
+    refine ⟨(cycleIso W U p K).symm x, ?_, (cycleIso W U p K).apply_symm_apply x⟩
+    refine ⟨(termIso W U p K 0).symm y, ?_⟩
+    change affineResidueDifferential W U p K 0 1 ((termIso W U p K 0).symm y) =
+      (termIso W U p K 1).symm x.val
+    apply (termIso W U p K 1).injective
+    rw [termIso_d, (termIso W U p K 1).apply_symm_apply,
+      (termIso W U p K 0).apply_symm_apply]
+    exact congrArg Subtype.val hy
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 600000 in
+-- Comparing the quotient and categorical homology instances expands the tensor carriers.
+private def quotientIso
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) :
+    affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+
+      ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).homology 1 :=
+  let C := (residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K
+  let S := C.sc' 0 1 2
+  let q := QuotientAddGroup.congr (affineResidueBoundaries W U p K)
+    S.moduleCatToCycles.range.toAddSubgroup (cycleIso W U p K) (boundaries_map W U p K)
+  q.trans ((S.moduleCatHomologyIso.symm ≪≫
+    (C.homologyIsoSc' 0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp)).symm).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv)
+
+private theorem quotientIso_class
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (x : affineResidueCycles W U p K) :
+    quotientIso W U p K (affineResidueCycleClass W U p K x) =
+      (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).homologyIsoSc'
+        0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp)).inv
+          ((((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).homologyπ
+            ((((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).moduleCatCyclesIso.inv
+              (cycleIso W U p K x))) := by
+  let C := (residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K
+  let S := C.sc' 0 1 2

+  apply congrArg ((C.homologyIsoSc' 0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp)).inv)
+  symm
+  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_π (cycleIso W U p K x)
+
+private def abstractCycle
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (x : affineResidueCycles W U p K) : ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).cycles 1 :=
+  (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).cyclesIsoSc'
+    0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp)).inv
+      ((((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).moduleCatCyclesIso.inv
+        (cycleIso W U p K x))
+
+private theorem abstractCycle_i
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (x : affineResidueCycles W U p K) :
+    ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).iCycles 1 (abstractCycle W U p K x) =
+      termIso W U p K 1 x.val := by
+  let C := (residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K
+  let S := C.sc' 0 1 2
+  have h₁ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+    (C.cyclesIsoSc'_inv_iCycles 0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp))
+      (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv (cycleIso W U p K x))
+  have h₂ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles
+    (cycleIso W U p K x)
+  exact h₁.trans h₂
+
+private theorem quotientIso_class_abstract
+    (K : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
+    (x : affineResidueCycles W U p K) :
+    quotientIso W U p K (affineResidueCycleClass W U p K x) =
+      ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).homologyπ 1 (abstractCycle W U p K x) := by
+  rw [quotientIso_class]
+  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+    (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).π_homologyIsoSc'_inv
+      0 1 2 (by simp) (by simp))
+        ((((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).sc' 0 1 2).moduleCatCyclesIso.inv
+          (cycleIso W U p K x))
+
+private theorem abstractCycle_naturality
+    {K C : CochainComplex
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ}
+    (φ : K ⟶ C) (x : affineResidueCycles W U p K) :
+    HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ) 1
+        (abstractCycle W U p K x) =
+      abstractCycle W U p C (affineResidueCycleMap φ x) := by
+  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective
+    (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj C).iCycles 1)).1 inferInstance
+  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+    (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ) 1)
+      (abstractCycle W U p K x)
+  calc
+    _ = ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ).f 1
+        (((residueComplexFunctor W U p).obj K).iCycles 1
+          (abstractCycle W U p K x)) := h
+    _ = ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ).f 1 (termIso W U p K 1 x.val) :=
+      congrArg _ (abstractCycle_i W U p K x)
+    _ = termIso W U p C 1 (affineResidueComponent φ 1 x.val) :=
+      (termIso_map W U p φ 1 x.val).symm
+    _ = _ := (abstractCycle_i W U p C (affineResidueCycleMap φ x)).symm
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- The statement compares tensor-product and quotient module structures.
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true in
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types true in
+/-- The explicit residue quotient computes tensor homology naturally in all chain maps.
+No perfectness, affinity or derived-category hypothesis is required for this algebraic step.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 010V; Mathlib's concrete module homology API.
+(blueprint: new-affine-residue-quotient-homology-naturality)
+
+Proof: Identify the ordinary residue tensor with scalar extension on each term.
+Restrict this natural term comparison to the kernels of the outgoing differentials.
+The image of the incoming differential corresponds to the incoming boundary
+submodule. Descend the kernel isomorphism to the quotient and use the canonical
+module homology isomorphism. Naturality of homology projections and the term
+comparison proves the equation first on cycle classes. Surjectivity of the
+cycle-class projection proves it on every homology class. -/
+theorem affine_residue_quotient_homology_naturality :
+    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+        ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
+    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
+      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
+    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (algebraMap Γ(W, U) p.ResidueField)
+    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
+    let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
+    ∃ e : ∀ K, affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ (G.obj K).homology 1,
+      ∀ K C (φ : K ⟶ C) z,
+        e C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) =
+          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map φ) 1 (e K z) := by
+  dsimp only
+  refine ⟨quotientIso W U p, ?_⟩
+  intro K C φ z
+  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (affineResidueCycleClass_surjective_kernel W U p K).1 z
+  rw [affineResidueCycleHomologyMap_class, quotientIso_class_abstract,
+    quotientIso_class_abstract, ← abstractCycle_naturality]
+  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
+    (HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality ((residueComplexFunctor W U p).map φ) 1)
+      (abstractCycle W U p K x)).symm
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+/-! # Factoring derived fibre cohomology through an open neighbourhood
+

+@[expose] public section

+/-- The residue morphism viewed inside an open neighbourhood of its image. -/
+def openResiduePoint (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) :
+    Spec (W.residueField w) ⟶ U.toScheme :=
+  Spec.map (asIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap ⟨w, hwU⟩)).inv ≫
+    U.toScheme.fromSpecResidueField ⟨w, hwU⟩
+
+private theorem openResiduePoint_comp (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens)
+    (hwU : w ∈ U) : openResiduePoint W w U hwU ≫ U.ι = W.fromSpecResidueField w := by
+  dsimp only [openResiduePoint]
+  rw [Category.assoc, ← Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField]
+  simp
+
+variable
+  [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
+    HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
+  [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
+    (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
+
+/-- Fibre cohomology on the localized module site, with its canonical field action. -/
+def localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W)
+    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (i : ℤ) :
+    DerivedCategory.{v + 1}
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
+        ModuleCat.{v} (W.residueField w) :=
+  let V : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) :=
+    (Modules.overEquiv U).functor
+  letI : V.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  V.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
+    derivedPullback (openResiduePoint W w U hwU) ⋙
+    DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
+      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (Spec (W.residueField w)).toRingedSpace)) i ⋙
+    SheafOfModules.evaluation
+      (moduleRings (Spec (W.residueField w)).toRingedSpace) (.op ⊤) ⋙
+    ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ΓSpecIso (W.residueField w)).inv.hom
+
+/-- A computation rule for the fibre functor, kept separate from its construction. -/
+theorem localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor_eq (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W)
+    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (i : ℤ) :
+    let V : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+        SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) :=
+      (Modules.overEquiv U).functor
+    letI : V.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+    localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w U hwU i =
+      V.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ derivedPullback (openResiduePoint W w U hwU) ⋙
+        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
+          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (Spec (W.residueField w)).toRingedSpace)) i ⋙
+            moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := W.residueField w) := rfl
+
+attribute [irreducible] localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor
+
+/-- Restriction to a neighbourhood computes fibre cohomology naturally on derived arrows.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 08DW, compatibility with restriction to opens.
+(blueprint: new-derived-fiber-open-factorization)
+
+Proof: Factor the residue morphism through U using the inverse of the residue-field
+map of the open immersion. Derived pullback along U's inclusion is naturally exact
+restriction to the localized module site followed by its canonical equivalence
+with modules on U.toScheme. Compose this comparison with the natural composition
+isomorphism for derived pullback and the factorization equation. Take homology
+and field-valued global sections. Every comparison is a natural isomorphism,
+so this works for all derived objects and arrows, without perfectness or affinity. -/
+theorem derived_fiber_open_factorization (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W)
+    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (i : ℤ) :
+    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
+      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
+        localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w U hwU i ≅
+          derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w i) := by
+  let R := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U
+  let V : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
+      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) :=
+    (Modules.overEquiv U).functor
+  have : V.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  let g := openResiduePoint W w U hwU
+  obtain ⟨a⟩ := pullbackOpenIso W U
+  obtain ⟨b⟩ := pullbackCompIso g U.ι
+  let θ : R.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ V.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
+      derivedPullback (W.fromSpecResidueField w) :=
+    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso R V).symm

+    (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M

+    (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f' k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj Mi
